# The Activity stylesheet moves its packaged URL while keeping the shared physical source

The new root chrome activity.css URL maps to the existing shared/mail/activity/activity.css source. Three platform import wrappers and 40PNG package entries/files are removed; the widget already selected SVGs. The defaultEventIcon.svg asset remains registered alongside the chosen defaultProcessIcon.svg. Keep packaged URL, physical source, binary identity and actual widget consumer separate: this change does not prove pixel equivalence or that every possible old asset consumer disappeared.

Scope: Activity resource packaging.
